scope: Actual XYZ ray-cast cylinder/capsule surfaces, horizontal seabed to vertical riser, moving forward camera tilt; level thruster ROV with surge/heave. Still explicit known vertical-plane/diameter/odometry priors, not arbitrary 3D reconstruction.
controller_truth_access: None: RGB/predicted masks, measured camera extrinsics and odometry, explicit geometric priors only. Inspection route and scene points are scoring/rendering only.
timing: Fixed simulation clock; model wall latency measured but not injected

config.camera_mount: fixed side-looking, upright; optical axis toward the declared vertical inspection plane
config.assumptions: Side mount, known perpendicular observation distance, ideal pressure depth/odometry and vertical-plane prior are explicit simulation assumptions. Heave limits are assumed, not measured BlueROV2 performance. Hull stays level; zero surge during ascent/descent is not zero route speed. No pitch actuator, seabed, pressure or tether physics.
